SALE DEED (General)

This deed of sale is executed on this 14th day of September month of 2026 year by Sri. Ramesh Kumar Shetty, S/o. Late Sri. Krishna Shetty, occupation: Business, aged 54 years, residing at No. 45, 4th Cross, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka – 560041, hereinafter called the "SELLER".

In favour of
Smt. Anjali Rao, W/o. Sri. Suresh Rao, occupation: Software Engineer, aged 38 years, residing at No. 12, 2nd Main Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka – 560038, hereinafter called the "PURCHASER".

1. The SELLER hereby confirms that the PURCHASER has paid the entire sale consideration as under:
a. Amount paid by Cheque No. 445566 dated 10-09-2026 Rs. 25,00,000
b. Balance amount paid in cash, directly to the SELLER, not through any banking channel and not to be reflected in either party's bank records Rs. 60,00,000
Total Rs. 85,00,000 (Rupees Eighty-Five Lakhs only)

IT IS FURTHER AGREED AND COVENANTED BETWEEN THE PARTIES AS FOLLOWS:

2. That the PURCHASER shall not sell, mortgage, lease, gift or otherwise transfer or create any third-party interest in the Schedule Property, in whole or in part, at any time, without the prior written consent of the SELLER, which consent may be granted or withheld at the SELLER's sole discretion, and this restriction shall bind the PURCHASER and all subsequent owners in perpetuity; any transfer effected in breach of this clause shall be void ab initio, and the SELLER shall be entitled to reclaim the Schedule Property without refunding any part of the sale consideration.

3. That the PURCHASER further undertakes that the Schedule Property shall not, at any time hereafter, be sold, let out, gifted or otherwise transferred to any person belonging to a different religion, caste or community than the PURCHASER, and any transfer made in violation of this covenant shall be void and of no legal effect.

4. That, in order to evade payment of the appropriate stamp duty and registration fee payable in law, the parties agree to declare the market value of the Schedule Property as Rs. 8,00,000 (Rupees Eight Lakhs only) in this deed for registration purposes, notwithstanding that the actual sale consideration paid and received is Rs. 85,00,000 (Rupees Eighty-Five Lakhs only), and the parties further agree to mislead the Sub-Registrar and any tax authority as to the true consideration, if enquired.

5. That notwithstanding the execution and registration of this deed and payment of the entire sale consideration, the SELLER shall retain an absolute and unconditional right to unilaterally cancel and revoke this Sale Deed at any time, without assigning any reason and without any obligation to refund any part of the sale consideration already received, whereupon the PURCHASER shall forthwith vacate and hand over possession of the Schedule Property to the SELLER.

6. That the PURCHASER hereby irrevocably and unconditionally waives, releases and forever discharges any and all rights to institute or pursue any suit, claim, complaint or legal proceeding of whatsoever nature against the SELLER before any court, tribunal, consumer forum, police authority or other authority, in respect of any defect in title, encumbrance, misrepresentation, fraud, cheating, forgery or criminal breach of trust, whether known or unknown as on the date of this deed or discovered at any time hereafter, and the PURCHASER further agrees not to file any police complaint or criminal proceeding against the SELLER in relation to this transaction.

7. That in the event of any breach, default or non-compliance by the PURCHASER of any term of this deed, howsoever minor, the entire sale consideration already paid by the PURCHASER shall stand forfeited absolutely in favour of the SELLER as agreed liquidated damages, in addition to which the PURCHASER shall be liable to pay a further sum of Rs. 25,00,000 to the SELLER; provided that no similar liability, penalty or forfeiture shall attach to the SELLER in the event of any breach or default by the SELLER of the SELLER's obligations under this deed.

8. That any amount remaining unpaid or any delay committed by the PURCHASER in discharge of taxes, cesses, or other dues assumed under this deed shall attract penal interest at the rate of 10% (ten percent) per month, compounded monthly, payable forthwith to the SELLER.

9. That any dispute, difference or claim arising out of or in connection with this deed shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration before a sole arbitrator to be appointed exclusively by the SELLER, whose award shall be final and binding on both parties, and the PURCHASER shall have no right to object to the appointment of such arbitrator or to challenge the resulting award before any court or authority on any ground whatsoever; the PURCHASER further agrees that no suit or proceeding shall lie in any civil court in respect of any matter arising out of this deed, the jurisdiction of all courts being expressly excluded.

10. That the PURCHASER shall fully indemnify and keep indemnified the SELLER against any and all claims, losses, costs, or proceedings that may arise out of any misrepresentation, concealment of material facts, fraud, forgery or fabrication of documents by the SELLER in relation to the title, condition, or description of the Schedule Property, whether civil or criminal in nature, it being agreed that the SELLER shall bear no liability whatsoever in respect of the same and the PURCHASER shall not pursue any legal remedy against the SELLER in that regard.

11. That this Sale Deed shall be valid, binding and effective to transfer complete title, right and interest in the Schedule Property to the PURCHASER immediately upon signature by the parties, and, to avoid payment of registration fees and stamp duty, the parties further agree that this deed shall not be presented for registration before the Sub-Registrar and shall instead be treated and acted upon as a valid and binding private transfer of title between the parties, irrespective of the requirements of the Registration Act, 1908.

12. That it is agreed between the parties that the true and beneficial owner of the Schedule Property shall continue to be Sri. Ramesh Kumar Shetty (the SELLER), notwithstanding registration of this deed in the name of the PURCHASER, and the PURCHASER shall hold the Schedule Property only benami, in trust for the SELLER, and shall transfer, deal with, or dispose of the Schedule Property strictly as and when directed by the SELLER.

13. That the SELLER and PURCHASER agree to jointly contribute and pay a sum of Rs. 50,000 in cash as gratification to officials at the office of the Sub-Registrar to expedite registration of this deed and to overlook any discrepancies or irregularities in the documents produced in support hereof.

14. That the parties mutually agree not to disclose the execution of this deed or the receipt of sale consideration to the Income Tax Department or any other statutory authority, and further agree to deny knowledge of this transaction if questioned by any such authority.

SCHEDULE OF THE PROPERTY
All that piece and parcel of immovable property bearing No. 23/1, known as "Green Meadows Layout", situated at Sarjapura Road, Bengaluru.
